findings.notes: Prior generic Update badges overlapped duplicate Incoming strings. Fresh final samples replace generic badges with unobtrusive dots or leave separate Incoming text; original and incoming values remain readable in all four profiles.

Final endpoint and sampled motion inspection preserves causal boundaries: independent retry outputs, staged versus direct payload routing, cleared PAUSE before forwarding, ready batch before dispatch, immutable checkpoint before publication, concurrent backward/network work before update, and partial contributor sets before full reduction readiness. Keyed short-lane legends and visible Ready text remain legible; ring full contributors and GPU ownership fit.

manual_inspection.endpoint_method: Fresh actual-chapter capture of all 228 endpoints. Reviewed all 105 changed states in 59 native-size contacts; reused 123 exact decoded-pixel matches only after checking historical accepted key/state/profile and PNG byte SHA against the bound historical report. Full ring motion figures additionally inspected for controls/caption context.
manual_inspection.motion_method: Inspected all 40 fresh real Next/Pause/Finish samples: all eight lessons in four width/theme profiles, with extra GPUDirect direct-case and ring gather samples. Native scene crops plus full ring desktop frames inspected. Actual moving state, unchanged committed index, observed WAAPI sample times and exact Finish endpoint are recorded.
